name: software-development-helper-skills
description: A collection of production-grade agent skills for software engineering tasks, project management, and development workflows.

skills.name: kanban-task-breakdown
skills.description: Break down features into standardized Trello/Kanban tickets using WBS principles, 7-component card structure, and status workflows. Supports detailed_mode parameter (less|normal|fully) for output verbosity control.

skills.name: design-thinking
skills.description: Facilitate the 5-step Design Thinking process (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test) to guide users from a vague problem to a validated solution. Step-by-step facilitation for beginners and experts across any domain, with HMW, SCAMPER, and Feedback Matrix frameworks.
